Select all IC50 activity rows in nM for human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL4282). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key and doc_id, then docs to get pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL4282, standard_type IC50, and standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
